resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (archive.org/details/2023-09-30-212529, a screenshot of 河池日报's 2022-09-14 story on the Da Ren industrial park gas connection) is a DEAD_LINK per the automated check because it's an image with no extractable text -- I could not requery a Wayback snapshot of it since it is itself already the archived copy, and there is no separate live origin URL to re-snapshot. Fresh Chinese search found an independent, verifiable replacement: 上海石油天然气交易中心 (shpgx.com), 2022-11-14, 保供有我系列报道 on the 广西天然气支线管网宜州支线 commissioning, which states in passing that 宜州支线 is '河池市投产的第三条天然气支线管道' (Hechi's third commissioned gas branch pipeline), following the 河池专供管道 and the 河池-南丹支线（大任段） (this row's segment) as the second. This confirms the Hechi-Nandan/Da Ren branch was already commissioned and in operation as of Nov 2022, corroborating Status=operating from a source independent of the wiki's original citation. Verified: url_verifier OK on tokens '大任'+'南丹'.

Guangxi DRC approval decree 桂发改油气〔2019〕1136号 ('广西壮族自治区发展和改革委员会关于广西天然气支线管网项目河池-南丹天然气支线管道工程项目核准的批复', 2019-12-03) describes the project as building ~113.56km of 天然气管道 (natural gas pipeline). This is a Wayback snapshot of the issuing agency's own gxzf.gov.cn page; url_verifier previously false-negatived on this exact page due to a charset auto-detection bug (server omits an explicit charset on a CJK page) -- that bug is now fixed in scripts/url_verifier.py (uncommitted working-tree fix, confirmed present) and the URL now passes cleanly, token '天然气管道' present. Note: archive.org's own screenshot of the same decree (details/2023-09-30-211609) still fails automated verification (image, no text layer) so I'm citing only the passing Wayback copy of the same document.

Inferential, not literal: no source uses the word 'transmission'. The decree describes a 4.0MPa branch running from a Hechi distribution station (河池分输站) to a new Nandan distribution station (南丹分输站) and onward to a downstream gas gate station (下游燃气门站) -- a high-pressure branch feeding city-gate/distribution infrastructure, consistent with the 'transmission' classification GEM uses across the rest of this Guangxi cluster, but I'm marking tier=low since it's an inference from technical description rather than a stated classification.

Partial support only: this 2022-11-14 shpgx.com article confirms the 河池-南丹支线（大任段） was already commissioned/operating as Hechi's second gas branch (before the 宜州支线, its third, went live around this article's date) -- consistent with StartYear1=2022, but the article does not give a month, so it does NOT specifically corroborate StartMonth1=9. Searched extensively (site-restricted and open Chinese queries) for a text-extractable republication or corroboration of the original 河池日报 2022-09-14 '大任产业园管输天然气正式通气' story (whose only known copy is the DEAD_LINK archive.org screenshot at details/2023-09-30-212529) but found none. Staging at tier=low as year-level-only support; the specific month=9 remains unconfirmed by any passing source.
Decree gives design throughput as 5.15亿m3/年 = 0.515 bcm/y; GEM records 0.52 bcm/y, a ~1% rounding difference, not material. Token '5.15亿' verified present on the passing Wayback copy of the decree.
Decree: '新建约113.56km的天然气管道' -- exact match to GEM's LengthKnown=113.56km. Token '113.56' verified present.
Decree: '管径分别为DN300(河池分输站-南丹分输站)和DN250(南丹分输站-下游燃气门站)' -- exact match to GEM's dual-diameter '300/250' mm. Token 'DN300' verified present.

The CURRENT value on the sheet ('Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network Hechi Branch') just restates the pipeline's own name -- exactly the pattern docs/reference/gem_schema.md's FuelSource gotcha bans (must name the upstream field/plant feeding the line, never the line itself). None of the sources read for this row (the 2019 approval decree, the shpgx.com commissioning-order article, or the earlier audit shard's EIA-cover-page screenshot) name a specific upstream gas field/plant/import terminal feeding this particular branch -- the broader Guangxi network draws on a mix of West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2 supply and Beihai LNG imports, but attributing one specific source to this one branch without a document that says so would be fabrication. Leaving unresolved per the schema's own instruction rather than sourcing the current self-referential value.

Decree confirms the route only at prefecture/county level: '项目建设地点位于河池市境内,途径金城江、宜州、南丹县(区)' (Hechi city, via Jinchengjiang, Yizhou, to Nandan county) -- consistent with StartPrefecture/District=Hechi (Jinchengjiang District start) and EndPrefecture/District=Hechi (Nandan County end). Tokens '金城江' and '南丹' both verified present. Could NOT independently confirm the village-level names already on the sheet (Podi Village/Dongjiang Town, Weiyong Village) -- targeted searches for those specific village names turned up nothing outside GEM's own wiki page. Staging this ref at district/county-level support only; tier=low because it doesn't reach village-level precision and does not contradict the recorded village names.
Decree: '本项目总投资约41346万元' = RMB 413,460,000.00 -- exact match. Token '41346' verified present. Decree does not state a cost year; leaving SegmentCostYear untouched.

Decree: '项目单位为广西广投天然气管网有限公司' -- exact match to the QCCOwner(业主单位) value already on the operators/owners tab. Token '广西广投天然气管网有限公司' verified present. Caveat: an EIA-report cover screenshot flagged in the earlier deep-sweep audit (archive.org/details/2023-09-30-212740, image-only, does not pass url_verifier) names the construction unit as 广西燃气集团有限公司 instead -- likely a parent/predecessor entity given Guangxi's provincial gas-network reorganizations; the 2019 decree is the more specific, later-stage document and matches GEM's existing value, so citing it alone.

Same decree names 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 as the sole project unit -- supports 100% ownership by this entity (Owner1='Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co Ltd', Owner1%='100.00%'). No other owner named in any source read for this row.
